title: Mitigate post-upgrade operator/helm hook race causing reconciliation storms in on-prem clusters
creator: Rhea Morgan
body:
Summary:
Several customers running Private (on-prem/VPC) reported service instability immediately after operator/helm-based upgrades. Symptoms include rapid operator leader-election churn, reconciliation loops that spike control-plane CPU, and transient webhook 5xx errors causing user-facing pod restarts. This ticket centralizes diagnosis, a short-term customer hotfix, and a longer-term safe-upgrade mode for the operator + helm chart to prevent recurrence.

Root cause hypothesis (what we've observed):
- Helm post-upgrade ordering can trigger Jobs and resource updates before the operator has fully synced CRs, creating a window where the operator sees resources in partial states.
- The operator's reconcile handler treats certain intermediate states as errors and queues large fan-out reconciles, which lead to leader re-election under heavy API load.
- Some installations with large CR counts and slow etcd see timeouts; the operator's default resync timing and aggressive backoff amplify the effect.

Impact:
- Multiple enterprise customers experienced brief outages or degraded throughput during upgrades (up to ~10 minutes in worst cases).
- Affected customers opened escalations and some requested immediate rollbacks.

Short-term mitigations included in this ticket (hotfix deliverables):
- Patch operator to detect helm upgrade annotations and enter a "graceful-upgrade" mode that limits fan-out reconciles and increases per-item backoff for 15 minutes post-upgrade.
- Add a Helm preflight hook manifest that verifies CRD/CR controller readiness (CR status observed and operator leader stable) before proceeding to jobs or application resources.
- Provide an on-prem safe-rollforward playbook for Support (commands, kubectl snippets, and when to initiate rollback).

Long-term proposals (follow-up work items):
- Implement a coordinator subcontroller that serializes critical resource transitions during operator upgrades.
- Add upgrade-time observability (upgrade window traces, reconcile queue metrics, event annotations) surfaced in Console.
- Teach the chart to include an opt-in "safeUpgrade=true" value that toggles the preflight and operator graceful mode.

Acceptance criteria:
- Hotfix operator build deployed to a staging on-prem cluster reproducing the issue: leader churn reduced to baseline and no 5xx webhooks during a simulated chart upgrade.
- Support playbook validated with at least two recent customer environments and reviewed by Solutions Engineering.
- PRs merged for operator patch and helm preflight; release artifact runtime-2.3.1-hotfix created and smoke-tested.

Rollout plan:
1) Cut hotfix image and helm chart snapshot.
2) Deploy to internal staging, run simulated upgrade with large CR set (500+ CRs) and slow etcd to verify improvement.
3) Release to a single low-risk customer cluster in coordination with CSM. Monitor 60m.
4) If stable, schedule phased rollout for other affected customers with 1-hour maintenance windows.
5) Communicate with customers using templated incident notes and include mitigation commands.

Risks and trade-offs:
- The graceful-upgrade mode may delay convergence for certain operations; we limit it to a short timebox (15 minutes) and make it configurable.
- Preflight checks could add a small upgrade latency; acceptable compared to customer-facing outages.

Links to artifacts and context:
- Support case cluster dump: https://redwood-support.example.com/cases/CS-4721 (redacted)
- Draft playbook (Confluence): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OPS/OnPrem+Upgrade+Safe+Mode
- PR (operator graceful-upgrade patch): https://github.com/redwood-inference/operator/pull/1283
- PR (helm preflight hook): https://github.com/redwood-inference/charts/pull/602
- Reproduction harness: https://github.com/redwood-inference/e2e-harness/tree/upgrade-race

updates: 2026-03-10: Initial triage by Rhea — collected customer logs and reproduction steps from Support.
2026-03-11: Diego reproduced leader-election churn in lab cluster with 600 CRs and 200ms etcd latency; created minimal patch to gate reconcile fanout.
2026-03-12: Operator patch (WIP) pushed to branch feature/graceful-upgrade; unit tests added for backoff behavior.
2026-03-13: Helm preflight PR opened; preflight checks pass in local integration but need e2e verification.
2026-03-14: Cut candidate hotfix image runtime-2.3.1-hotfix-canary. Deploying to staging for load test overnight.
comments: Maya Chen (Support): Confirmed two customers (ACME Corp, Finnova) saw outages aligned with their scheduled upgrades. Both are on older etcd tunings.
Priya Nair (Solutions Eng): Agrees playbook steps are clear; request to include kubectl commands to pause the helm release and re-run preflight if needed.
Liam O'Connor (SRE): Suggested adding a metric 'operator.upgrade_in_progress' to reduce alert noise during planned upgrades.
Diego Alvarez: Working on telemetry changes; will add a reconcile-queue length histogram to the operator metrics.
Rhea Morgan: After staging validation we'll coordinate with CSM for first-customer pilot on 2026-03-18.
